**Present Perfect:** have / has + **V3**:
**Present Perfect:** have / has + **V3** — *I've seen · She hasn't called · Have you been…?*
**Past Simple:** V2 / -ed — *I saw · She didn't call · Did you go…?*

Słowa, które podpowiadają czas:
- Present Perfect: *ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, recently, today, this week, for, since*
- Past Simple: *yesterday, last week, ago, in 2020, when I was a child, then* i pytanie *When…?*

Typowa rozmowa: pytanie lub nowina — Present Perfect, szczegóły — Past Simple:
*Have you ever been to Rome? — Yes, I **went** there in 2023. We **stayed** for a week.*
Did you see Anna this morning? (ранок ми: Did you see Anna this morning? (ranek już minął)
She worked here for 3 years. (вже ні): She worked here for 3 years. (już nie)
She's worked here for 3 years. (і далі п: She's worked here for 3 years. (i nadal pracuje)
last week — точний час у минулому, тому: last week — dokładny czas w przeszłości, więc Past Simple.
since + досі → Present Perfect: I have l: since + do dziś → Present Perfect: I have lived here since 2020.
today, this week, this year — поки не ск: today, this week, this year — dopóki się nie skończyły, Present Perfect.
yet у британській англійській — з Presen: yet w brytyjskim angielskim — z Present Perfect: jeszcze nie zrobione do tej chwili.

Новину повідомляємо в Present Perfect, п: Nowinę przekazujemy w Present Perfect, szczegóły — kiedy, gdzie, jak — w Past Simple.

Перше питання — про досвід → Present Per: Pierwsze pytanie — o doświadczenie → Present Perfect: Have you (ever) been…?
Питання з **When…?** — завжди Past Simpl: Pytanie z **When…?** — zawsze Past Simple: *When did you arrive?* (nie ~~When have you arrived?~~).
